label: The extension's fail-closed keeps only pinned and disableModelInvocation skills; invalid policies never fail open; default failMode closed with timeoutMs 8000 and a closed set of safe error codes.

Fail-open and fail-closed invert between a filter and an additive hint: the advisor's empty fail-open already equals the extension's fail-closed outcome minus pins, so porting the fail-closed default by name changes nothing.

ADAPT: the Claude advisor hook's unhandled-exception and parse-failure paths return an empty object, so the model gets no outage directive and cannot tell a crash from a disabled advisor; emitting the static timeout fallback text on the unhandled catch would close it. Non-Claude hooks unverified.
The extension warns the operator per failed decision (skipping aborted) and points at /decisions status; the advisor only has rolling fail-open warn and page rates, which miss a single silent crash.

REJECT an operator-pinned always-surface set in the advisor brief: pins exist in the extension because filtering can hide a skill, the advisor never hides one, and a pin would add constant per-prompt churn the directive dedup removes; Gate 2 artifact triggers already cover always-route needs.

ADAPT opt-in: the extension history records per-skill score and threshold or a pinned/base/unknown mark; the advisor's persisted record strips skillLabel unless SKILL_ADVISOR_DEBUG and carries no confidence or lane, so why-surfaced is answerable only by a live re-run; add confidence, uncertainty and dominantLane under the debug flag only.
Any advisor why-view should follow the extension's recorded-not-inferred rule: show what was recorded at emit time and mark gaps unknown, never a fresh re-score presented as history.
